notes.title: "Matchmaker Bay" Version Coming Soon – A Look Back at All Updates Since Launch
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This is the team behind Matchmaking Inc.—Wave Games (the developers) and our pals at LightningGames (the publishers). Today marks three months since the game's launch, and we’ve been working non-stop on optimizations and new content. Soon, you’ll get to experience some fresh updates!  

In case you missed what we’ve been up to, here’s a recap of all 27 updates since release:  

🆕 New Additions
🔹 Added full voice acting for the female protagonist, plus tons of new voice lines for main quests, side quests, and random events.  
🔹 Introduced a shop ranking system and expanded the achievement system.  
🔹 Added multiple new commission quests.  
🔹 New helper character [Auntie Wang] with her own story, side quests, and skills.  
🔹 Full controller support + Mac & Linux beta versions (with cross-platform cloud saves!).  
🔹 New gear and equipment.  
🔹 Added a mentorship UI and card recommendation feature for smoother gameplay.  
🔹 Launched the "Magpie Bridge Matchmaking Festival" event.  

✨ Optimizations 
⭐ Revamped the main quest [Secondhand Dating] with adjusted story flow and comic-style cutscenes.  
⭐ Improved the Wishing Pool mechanic—now with a 50-pull pity system and higher drop rates for rare rewards.  
⭐ Rebalanced card effects and gameplay.  
⭐ Tweaked mini-game skill progression for better pacing.  
⭐ Polished dialogue in main/side quests, reducing repetitive choices.  
⭐ Upgraded the fishing system—adult fish now sell for more, and bait is more effective.  

🐞 Fixes  
✅ Fixed visual bugs in Matchmaker Bay, broken hotkeys in persuasion minigames, and softlocks when talking to NPCs (like the Financial Center receptionist).  
✅ Fixed mismatched voice/text in cutscenes, quest triggers failing, and incorrect map markers.  
✅ Corrected gear descriptions, bugged card effects, erroneous UI alerts, and other minor issues.  
✅ Resolved save/load crashes, notification glitches, mini-game hotkey conflicts, and character interaction freezes.  
✅ Fixed quest refresh bugs, typos, animation clipping, and misplaced NPCs.  
✅ Ensured backward compatibility for old saves and cross-version quests.  

---  
We’ve delivered on most of our post-launch promises, and now we’re deep into prepping the Matchmaker Bay expansion while also working on Steam Deck compatibility—localization is coming along nicely, so stay tuned!  

As always, we’re committed to making Matchmaking Inc. the best it can be. Thanks for your support, and we can’t wait to keep growing this journey with you all! 🎉💪❤️

notes.title: Feb. 7 [Patch Notes]
notes.content:
Hello everyone, regarding the card adjustments made yesterday, some of the intended changes were accidentally omitted. Therefore, we have implemented additional adjustments today.

1. The adjustments to the cards are not meant to restrict the use of certain strategies or to encourage players to adopt a fixed strategy. Instead, they aim to:
   - Ensure that all strategies have value, rather than making one strategy the only viable option.
   - Prevent any single card from being overwhelmingly powerful and mindlessly included in any deck.
   - Reduce the repetition of the same action during a single persuasion attempt.

2. For the currently popular card-drawing strategy, there are two main adjustments (one was implemented in yesterday's update, and the other was omitted and has been added today):
   - Weakened [Positive Thinking], reducing its individual card value while keeping the number of cards drawn unchanged, ensuring it doesn't affect the initiation and potential of the card-drawing strategy.
   - Enhanced [Pie in the Sky], significantly improving the initiation speed and potential of the card-drawing strategy.

3. For non-card-drawing strategies that use [Positive Thinking] solely as a means to draw cards:
   - Due to the correction of the [Drunkenness] buff (its effect has been doubled), it actually yields higher benefits than before the adjustment. Additionally, we have collected a lot of feedback from players regarding issues such as high repetition in mid-to-late game card play. In a major update within February, the skill of the helper [Auntie Wang] will be revamped. After unlocking [Auntie Wang], the maximum membership fee obtained from inviting ordinary members will be recorded. Subsequently, when encountering ordinary members with the same condition card, the persuasion process can be skipped, and the recorded maximum membership fee can be obtained directly.
     - Example: If you previously encountered an ordinary member with the [Stingy] condition and obtained 30,000 in membership fees, the next time you encounter an ordinary member with the same [Stingy] condition, you can "choose" to invite them directly and receive 30,000 in membership fees (the final value will account for current bonuses). Alternatively, you can "choose" to challenge again to refresh the previously recorded maximum fee.

4. **Card Adjustments:**
   - [Pie in the Sky]
     After adjustment: Increases membership fees by 60, then increases by 30 for each card drawn.
     Before adjustment: Increases membership fees by 60, then increases by 20 for each card drawn.
   - [Improvise]
     Patience cost adjusted to 1 (previously 0).
     After adjustment: Choose to add 1 Communication or Bargaining card to your hand and reduce its patience cost to 0.

Hello everyone, I am one of the producers of "Chinese Parenting." In our newly developed game, "Chinese Dating 2," you will embark on a dramatic and delightfully entertaining gaming experience. Playing as a young individual who returns to their hometown to take over the family business, you will encounter childhood friends, schoolmates, and loved ones, unraveling captivating stories of destiny. Each character has a unique personality and storyline, awaiting your careful exploration and courageous pursuit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/8636bf8108c264ee81b8083b2fd9220165ce8b92.png[/img]
However, please remember that this is only a Demo test version, and it is not the final representation of "Chinese Dating 2." Everything you see in the game may undergo changes in the official release because we are committed to providing the best gaming experience. So, when you begin testing, please keep an open mind and provide timely feedback on any issues you encounter. We will strive to do our best to ensure that every player can enjoy the optimal gaming experience.

Your feedback is crucial at this stage. We encourage every friend to share your opinions and suggestions, whether it's about gameplay, storylines, or any aspects that feel right or need improvement. We hope that each friend can become a part of our game development process.

In the coming days, we will continue to work hard to improve the game content, including more exciting emotional storylines, character growth, and dating systems, to bring you more surprises and enjoyment. Also, if there are any specific features you are looking forward to experiencing, characters you want to know more about, or gameplay elements you want to explore in-depth, please add them to your wishlist on the store page. This will greatly help us, and we sincerely appreciate it.

notes.title: Limited-time, unlimited Demo testing for June 30th is now open.
notes.content:
Dear player friends,

The moment of excitement is approaching! We are thrilled to announce that "Chinese Dating 2" will take you into a captivating world of love. It is not just a game but also an opportunity for communication and connection. We will officially launch a limited-time, unlimited Demo on June 30th, inviting you to explore the direction of our production, listen to progress updates, and provide your valuable feedback.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/1979755f6ad0c1df1c2478eb5f9c015e0b64c588.jpg[/img]

Firstly, we want to be honest with you that the Demo version is not yet perfect, and there may be some technical issues and design flaws. Our team has been working hard to improve the game, and the Demo serves as an opportunity for us to interact with players, better understand your feedback and opinions, and further enhance the quality of the game.

In "Chinese Dating 2," we delve deep into the purest and most sincere emotions between people. You will play as a young person returning to your hometown to take on the family business. Here, you will encounter childhood playmates, schoolmates, relatives, and friends. In this familiar yet mysterious town, the red thread of fate will unexpectedly emerge, and your story will unfold here.

In the Demo version, you will be able to engage in skill development, experience the basic gameplay of the dating club, participate in matchmaking, win membership privileges, complete main quests and side quests, explore the scene interaction system and special events system, and invite others to strategic card games and enjoy various mini-games. The dating club, cake shop, bookstore, hospital, ramen shop, nightclub, gym, internet cafe, large shopping mall, car dealership, central park, and other scenes await your exploration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/524dc51edf980b69054816943137ae5df05a7f62.jpg[/img]

However, the Demo only represents a small portion of the game. In the full version, you will encounter more surprises and touching moments. The multi-dimensional emotional connections between the protagonist and the heroines, the character's growth journey, the challenges of simulation management, and the rich dating system will provide you with a more immersive gaming experience. We promise to meticulously craft every detail, making each date and conversation feel genuine and emotionally resonant.

We deeply understand that love is the most beautiful language in the world, and everyone longs to be warmed by sincere emotions. In "Chinese Dating 2," we will present those beautiful moments and heartwarming experiences in the form of a game. Whether you believe in fate or dare to pursue, you will find your own happiness in this world.

Thank you for your support and anticipation!

notes.title: Mysterious Disappearance Operation (Steam Play Festival)
notes.content:
Mysterious Disappearance Operation (Steam Play Festival)
Regarding the "Incident" during the Play Festival
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/6729b7e2d75c115886cdcb0987ba3186329a00b1.jpg[/img]

Q: Is it a "story" or an "incident"? Please clarify!
A: We had originally planned to participate in the Steam Play Festival (June 19th - June 25th). However, as you know, life is like a box of chocolates, you never know what flavor you're going to get. Just as we were gearing up and getting ready to jump in, we made a decision... we backed out!
[Emphasizing the key point] We didn't back out because we were afraid, but because we realized that our product hadn't reached the desired state for a demo. We didn't want to waste this valuable opportunity, and of course, we didn't want to disappoint everyone's expectations.
So, what's our plan moving forward? We decided to postpone the testing instead of canceling it. So rest assured, we're not abandoning you halfway.

Q: How long will it be postponed? What's the plan?
A:
Testing Time: Changed to around June 29th
Testing Platform: Steam
Testing Period: 10 days
Testing Scope: "Unlimited" playable demo experience

Q: What will be available to play?
A: The game demo content is not yet complete. That's also why we decided to withdraw from this play festival.
Features: Character development, club gameplay, matchmaking, membership acquisition, main quests, side quests, skill system, scene interaction system, strategic card invitations, mini-games, and other basic gameplay elements.

Scenes: Matchmaking club, cake shop, library, hospital, ramen shop, nightclub, gym, internet cafe, large shopping mall, hot pot restaurant, central park, and more.

Heroines: Four (Ye Qingyu, Nicole, Lin Xi, Gu Meng)

Q: How much of the version is still unfinished?
A: Currently, it may be around 20% complete.
For example, in the quest category:
Heroine date quests, heroine side quests, marriage quests, etc.
For example, in the scene category:
Bathhouse, a specific property, car dealership, civil affairs bureau, etc.
The above content is either incomplete or hasn't even started yet. Even in the current version, we are not satisfied with many aspects, including smoothness, the logicality of daily events, the way heroines appear, and so on.

Q: If it's not enjoyable, can we curse?
A: No, please don't o(╥﹏╥)o!! We actually hope you can provide us with more feedback and suggestions rather than resorting to cursing. We know there is still a lot we need to improve, so please give us guidance and understanding.

Developer's Message:
This is a challenging theme, and the process is full of various obstacles. However, we still hope to do it well and present it to you as close to perfection as possible. Before you start typing criticisms, we want to say thank you. Thank you for still willing to type and express your expectations and emotions, with that feeling of wanting us to do better. Every word and every expectation from you is a connection and a source of motivation for us.

Overall, we may have been overly ambitious and not adequately prepared. However, we decided to listen to our hearts, delay our testing, and not rush into launching. We hope to provide you with a better experience, and we hope you can understand our decision.

Let's look forward to that future day when our game shines on your computer screen, and we can say together, "This is what we've been waiting for! This is what we wanted!" That moment will be the culmination of all the waiting and effort,

notes.title: 《中国式相亲2》研发日志#2~月老玩法
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/17c19fe044601cc31c10aab557866f6566e4db19.jpg[/img]在游戏中，我接手了家里的婚介所生意。
以前没有好好了解过家里生意的我。要怎么开始？从哪里下手？才能让家里唯一的经济来源可以持续输出呢？

下面我就来给大家介绍一下，相亲会所的玩法。（6月Steam试玩节有机会体验到的内容）

既然是婚介所，那么得有适龄男女会员才有机会为他们进行匹配。从而促成一桩好事。
那么我就来说说，成为恋人一共分几步。

第一步：在城市中去寻找他们，并推荐我们的婚介所
你可以在城市里去寻找未婚男女。使用各类技能如：巧舌如簧、命中注定、直击心灵等。
（邀请NPC加入相亲会所需要通过策略打牌游戏。根据NPC的性格和需求，玩家需要选择合适的出手策略和卡牌进行对战。打赢对战后，NPC会成为会所会员）
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/3c17e999721aa6ee0096650ec9313cde9c2910e3.png[/img]

第二步：在婚介所中为他们寻找心仪的伴侣 
成为会员的NPC将会出现在会所会员名单上。他们每个人都对自己的另一半有不同的要求，比如有人希望自己的另一半是个大学生，有人希望自己的另一半拥有一套住房，有人需求自己的另一半一定要风趣幽默等。找到满足双方诉求的人，并安排他们聊一聊。这就是我们要做事情。具体能否成功还是要看他们之间是否有感觉。
（根据会员的词条进行匹配。匹配成功后，玩家可以获得会所声望，用于提升会所等级。匹配过程中，玩家需要考虑会员的需求和条件，为他们寻找合适的伴侣）
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/8e1f23111807694b0e8f3e2dbf6f9bdef739e8a2.png[/img]

第三步：观察是否可婚配，不合适就拉回来“回炉”。
哈哈哈，这步是开玩笑的。完成第一、二步我们这个月老的角色就算是完成了。
